cues: The rate is the slope of the concentration time curve, divided by the coefficient.
The rate law is found by experiment, and the units of k reveal the order.
Order can be zero or fractional, molecularity cannot.
Zero order runs in a straight line, first order decays exponentially with a constant half life of point six nine three over k.
Only collisions with enough energy and the right orientation succeed, which Arrhenius captured in one equation.
And a catalyst lowers the barrier both ways, changing neither delta H nor the equilibrium.
text: Let us recap. The rate is the slope of the concentration time curve, divided by the coefficient. The rate law is found by experiment, and the units of k reveal the order. Order can be zero or fractional, molecularity cannot. Zero order runs in a straight line, first order decays exponentially with a constant half life of point six nine three over k. Only collisions with enough energy and the right orientation succeed, which Arrhenius captured in one equation. And a catalyst lowers the barrier both ways, changing neither delta H nor the equilibrium.
